title: SharP: Soft and Hard Prompt-Guided Augmentation with LLM for Low Resource Fake News Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.13207v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fake news detection under low resource conditions is challenged by the scarcity of labeled data and the difficulty of capturing subtle deceptive patterns. In this work, we focus on low resource fake news detection, where only a small labeled set is available for training, while evaluation is performed under a fixed and unchanged test protocol. This setting is motivated by costly, ambiguous fact-checking and emerging topics and domains that are poorly covered by existing benchmarks. Existing data augmentation methods, such as synonym substitution, generative adversarial networks, and large language model (LLM)-based generation, often produce fluent but overly generic content, lacking the task-specific relevance needed for accurate detection. To address this, we propose SharP, a boundary-aware text generation framework guided by soft and hard prompts, which leverages LLMs as tools adapted to produce task-specific synthetic samples. translated_title: SharP：基于软硬提示引导的大语言模型数据增强方法用于低资源虚假新闻检测
translated_abstract: 低资源条件下的虚假新闻检测面临着标注数据稀缺以及难以捕捉细微欺骗模式的挑战。在这项工作中，我们专注于低资源虚假新闻检测场景，即仅有少量标注数据可用于训练，同时在固定不变的测试协议下进行评估。这一设定的动机在于：事实核查成本高昂且存在歧义性，以及新兴主题和领域在现有基准数据集中覆盖不足。现有的数据增强方法，如同义词替换、生成对抗网络以及基于大语言模型（LLM）的生成方法，往往产生流畅但过于笼统的内容，缺乏准确检测所需的任务特定相关性。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SharP，一个由软提示和硬提示共同引导的边界感知文本生成框架，它将大语言模型作为工具，用于生成任务特定的合成样本。
tldr: 该论文提出SharP框架，通过软硬提示引导大语言模型进行边界感知的文本生成，为低资源虚假新闻检测生成具有任务特定相关性的合成训练样本，以克服现有数据增强方法生成内容过于笼统的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SharP, a boundary-aware text generation framework guided by soft and hard prompts that leverages LLMs as tools to generate task-specific synthetic samples, addressing the problem of overly generic augmented content in low-resource fake news detection.
